rows.title: Couple’s passionate moment at national park livestreamed to world｜Taiwan News
rows.description:
Bilingual text here: https://english.ftvnews.com.tw/news/2026515W09EA?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description

Our official website: ➔ https://english.ftvnews.com.tw/

Follow us on
Facebook: ➔ https://www.facebook.com/ftvformosanews
X (Twitter): ➔ https://x.com/FTV_Taiwan_News
A 23-year-old man and his girlfriend inadvertently became the stars of an adult cam show during a moment of passion at Yangmingshan National Park. The two lovers were having a heart-to-heart exchange on a picnic table at night, which was followed by a body-to-body exchange captured on a security cam livestream. More than 1,000 people tuned in to watch the spectacle, which could come at the price of a NT$9,000 or 1 year in prison for public indecency.

A sleepless couple admires the mountain scenery as they have a heart-to-heart. Moments later, passion took over.

Lee Yu-han
FTV reporter
Qingtiangang is an ideal spot for a romantic late night outing with your significant other. But if things get steamy, be warned that there is a camera livestreaming your every nook and cranny.

The young lovers got their heart pumping here, at the Qingtiangang Grassland on Yangmingshan. And their tender moments were broadcast for the world to see. This picnic table has become a red-hot destination, luring many people over for a look.

Member of public
Visiting picnic table
I came here expressly to check out this landmark. It’s crazy. Why would anyone get it on in full view of the camera!

Member of public
Visiting picnic table
Everyone on Threads was posting about it. I also caught a bit of the livestream last night. I wanted to see if there were any traces of the moment, but no.

After the incident came to light, cleaning staff was dispatched to give the table a thorough wipe. The livestream footage wasn’t very clear as it was late at night, but the sounds of love were captured by the camera’s microphone. The intimate meeting however, constitutes a crime of public indecency, and police have tracked down a 23-year-old man surnamed Kao thanks to his license plate. He admitted to driving his girlfriend up the mountain and said he would take time off work to make a statement with the police, but apparently didn’t show up.

Lee Yu-sheng
Lawyer unrelated to case
Be it intentionally or not, if you are filmed by a security camera, as long as you are seen or heard by strangers in a public space, it constitutes as public indecency.

The security camera inadvertently became an adult live cam, garnering more than 1,000 simultaneous viewers. In contrast, the other cams at the national park get single-digit figures at best. But this moment of glory could cost the couple a penny, as they are now facing up to a year behind bars or a fine of up to NT$9,000.

Clear black-and-white fisheye security camera footage at night, high contrast, slight VHS distortion, fine film grain. Only one adult tabby cat is in this scene. The single cat walks carefully along a narrow high-rise balcony railing with city streetlights glowing far below. It pauses, looks down, then leaps off the railing as if falling. The camera tilts and pans smoothly downward in one continuous motion, showing the city lights below. The same cat then climbs back up from a lower ledge beneath the railing It steps closer to the lens and stares directly into the camera. One continuous real-time take, natural motion, no slow motion. There are no duplicate cats — only one cat is visible in the entire video.

Image prompt 2: 
static shot, nighttime, clear black-and-white doorbell security camera footage with timestamp in corner. Slight fisheye perspective showing porch entry, faint street background with distant streetlights. From the start of the shot, a scruffy tabby cat is already walking straight toward the doorbell camera, centered in frame. It steadily approaches, paws landing softly on the porch steps, whiskers twitching, eyes fixed on the lens. The cat closes the distance until its face fills the frame, nose almost touching the camera.
